astropy_cstack_ndarray_right_operand_fix.title: astropy _cstack ndarray right-operand fix and next steps
astropy_cstack_ndarray_right_operand_fix.content: In astropy/modeling/separable.py, the separability bug for nested CompoundModels was traced to _cstack(left, right). In the branch where right is already an ndarray (a computed submatrix from a nested compound), the code incorrectly wrote ones into the bottom-right block: `cright[-right.shape[0]:, -right.shape[1]:] = 1`. The evidenced fix is to preserve the actual computed separability submatrix instead: `cright[-right.shape[0]:, -right.shape[1]:] = right`. The patch has been applied in the working tree. Next steps: verify the provided reproducer inside the docker testbed, then run `./run_tests.sh` and continue iterating until the official VERDICT is RESOLVED.

astropy_cstack_patch_applied_in_separabl.title: astropy _cstack patch applied in separable.py pending verification
astropy_cstack_patch_applied_in_separabl.content: In this session, the nested CompoundModel separability bug was reproduced inside the container using separability_matrix(m.Pix2Sky_TAN() & (m.Linear1D(10) & m.Linear1D(5))), which incorrectly showed the two Linear1D outputs as mutually dependent. The source patch has now been applied directly in testbed/astropy/modeling/separable.py within _cstack(left, right): in the branch where right is already an ndarray, the assignment was changed from cright[-right.shape[0]:, -right.shape[1]:] = 1 to cright[-right.shape[0]:, -right.shape[1]:] = right. This preserves the computed nested separability submatrix instead of replacing it with ones. Verification had started but was not yet completed; next resume by rerunning the Python reproducer in the container to confirm the nested case now matches the expected matrix, then run ./run_tests.sh until it reports VERDICT: RESOLVED.

astropy_cstack_ndarray_copy_patch_valida.title: astropy _cstack ndarray copy patch validated with nested reproducer, run_tests pending
astropy_cstack_ndarray_copy_patch_valida.content: In this session, astropy/modeling/separable.py was patched in _cstack(left, right): when right is already an ndarray, the code now copies the computed right submatrix with `cright[-right.shape[0]:, -right.shape[1]:] = right` instead of incorrectly filling that block with ones. After the patch, the reported reproducer inside the container changed from the buggy nested result to the expected matrix: `separability_matrix(m.Pix2Sky_TAN() & (m.Linear1D(10) & m.Linear1D(5)))` now matches the flat composition case and shows the two Linear1D outputs as separable/independent. The next step is to inspect the in-flight official `./run_tests.sh` result or rerun it if needed, and continue iterating until it prints `VERDICT: RESOLVED`.
